children: EDMONTON, AB – TheNewswire - September 14, 2026  — Knower Tech, a division of Know Company, announced that its President, Stephanie McCabe, has been named to the 2026 WXN Top 100 Award, recognizing Canada's most powerful women. McCabe was honoured in the Executive Leaders category, presented by CN.

In her leadership position at Knower Tech, McCabe helms a fast growing business, spanning Canada and the U.S., with a combination of customer focused perspective, the ability to move fast and innovate, and a commitment to the communities the company services.

Knower Tech builds proprietary programmatic tools — spanning data activation, curation, audience targeting, AI-assisted campaign management, and verification — giving brands and agencies the execution power to match the relationships they've already built. Its portfolio includes RainBarrel, Real Impression, and AdsCopilot.

"To be included among this group of transformational leaders is an honour and a commitment to continue leading boldly," said McCabe. "My career has been focused on leading change, connecting with the people I work with, and contributing to my communities — including the independent agencies and brands we work with. This recognition is deeply valued."

"Stephanie's leadership has been central to what Knower Tech has become," said Vikram Seth, CEO of Know Company. "She's built a culture around the belief that independent agencies do some of the best work in this industry  and this recognition reflects the vision she's brought to helping them do even more of it. We’re ecstatic to see her recognized as the national leader that she is."

Before joining Knower Tech, McCabe served as Deputy City Manager for the City of Edmonton, where she led efficiency initiatives for the city and local businesses. She is a Board Director and Chair of the Funding Priorities Committee for the Stollery Children's Hospital Foundation and holds the ICD.D designation.

The WXN Top 100 Awards celebrate Canada's most accomplished women across business, government, entrepreneurship, and STEM, selected by an independent panel of judges from a nationwide pool of nominees.

Knower Tech, a division of Know Company, builds proprietary programmatic tools — spanning data activation, curation, audience targeting, AI-assisted campaign management, and verification — that help brands and agencies execute with greater agility, transparency, and measurable results. Its products include RainBarrel audience targeting and curation, Real Impression ad verification, and AdsCopilot, an AI-powered Chrome extension for campaign planning and execution.

title: Knower Tech President Stephanie McCabe Named to Canada's Top 100 Most Powerful Women
